items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Yeah. Rocells had a good band.

ctx.x: Pop said there was something called the Rocell Band or something. Do you remember that name? Rocells? I don't know. I didn't get the name right.
Yeah. Rocells had a good band. Rocells? Yeah. Rocells. Yeah. Rocells. They had a very good band. Was that the name of the musician? Rocells. Yeah. That was the name of the musician.
And Pop Foster said something about Joe Johnson, the trumpet player.
